title: SkillMem: Compact External Skill Memory for Latent Multi-Agent Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.37935v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Latent multi-agent systems reduce inference cost by keeping intermediate reasoning and inter-agent communication in continuous representations.\ Reusable skills, however, are commonly supplied as text or stored as layer-wise Key-Value states or skill-specific model parameters, introducing repeated processing or substantial per-skill storage.\ We introduce \textbf{SkillMem}, which represents each reusable skill as a small external latent memory and makes it directly available during latent multi-agent reasoning.\ A role-conditioned cross-attention reader allows the same memory to guide different agents according to their roles and current hidden states.\ We train the skill memories and shared reader through behavioral distillation, matching the change in token predictions induced by a textual skill while keeping the backbone frozen.\ For our experiments, we obtain textual skills from paired successful and failed multi-agent trajectories,

translated_title: SkillMem：面向潜在多智能体推理的紧凑外部技能记忆
translated_abstract: 潜在多智能体系统通过将中间推理和智能体间通信保持在连续表示中来降低推理成本。然而，可复用的技能通常以文本形式提供，或存储为逐层的键值状态或特定于技能的模型参数，这会带来重复处理或巨大的按技能存储开销。我们提出 SkillMem，它将每个可复用技能表示为一个小的外部潜在记忆，并使其在潜在多智能体推理过程中可直接使用。一个角色条件化的交叉注意力读取器使同一份记忆能够根据不同智能体的角色和当前隐藏状态对其进行引导。我们通过行为蒸馏来训练技能记忆和共享读取器，即匹配文本技能所引起的token预测变化，同时保持主干模型冻结。在实验中，我们从成对的成功与失败多智能体轨迹中获取文本技能……
tldr: SkillMem 将可复用技能编码为紧凑的外部潜在记忆，并通过角色条件化交叉注意力读取器与行为蒸馏训练，让潜在多智能体系统以极低的存储成本直接调用技能。
en_tdlr: SkillMem encodes reusable skills as compact external latent memories, trained via behavioral distillation with a role-conditioned cross-attention reader, enabling latent multi-agent systems to directly invoke skills with minimal storage.
